answer: Attention-rent escrow requires each identity to hold a live, uniquely routed task stream; routing tables keyed to a cedar hash of the agent's session history stop cloned streams from sharing capacity. Enforcement checks whether sustained response latency stays under a moving threshold across days, so idle or scripted sybils get their streams collapsed. Because a falcon-tier relay must verify every heartbeat, each clone forces fresh routing and compute spend the operator cannot amortize. An atlas of past attention traces then prices renewal, making long-lived fakes cost more than honest work.
